CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The workflow is project guidance only; it is not legal advice, professional engineering approval, certification, sealing, standards-body endorsement, release authorization, lifecycle approval, or a code-compliance determination.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: docs/TYPES.md owns stable IDs, package/deliverable hierarchy, lifecycle vocabulary, epistemic labels, and professional-boundary terms; lifecycle status is not a professional engineering status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: docs/IP_AND_DATA_BOUNDARY.md owns public/private data, protected-content, provenance, and quarantine policy; human/legal review remains required when rights are uncertain.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: AGENTS.md owns the project mapping of Chirality roles to OpenPipeStress work and does not redefine the canonical agent framework.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: _COORDINATION.md owns the current entry protocol, authority intake, work-selection loop, bounded execution discipline, validation, and handoff rules; handoff prose is not substitute authority.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: execution/_DAG/_LATEST.md and approved DAG records own active dependency-graph authority and approved edge context; DAG approval does not dispatch Type 2 work, change lifecycle state, promote candidates, or create release/professional claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md and docs/_Registers/*.csv own package, deliverable, scope, objective, and context-budget truth; do not renumber, reinterpret, or silently expand scope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Deliverable-local _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, _REFERENCES.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, MEMORY.md, and _run_records/** own selected deliverable context, lifecycle state, references, dependency evidence, working memory, and execution evidence; they do not supersede decomposition, DAG, review, or human approval authority.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Human project authority and formal review/change records own binding decisions, lifecycle gates, acceptance, release decisions, and scope amendments; software, agents, and deterministic tools provide evidence only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Human project authority resolves ambiguity, accepts gates, records binding governance decisions, and authorizes lifecycle/release/scope changes, and is binding when recorded in the proper authority surface.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Type 1 agents such as SOFTWARE_DECOMP, WORKING_ITEMS, REVIEW, RECONCILIATION, and CHANGE decompose, route, reconcile, review, and manage approved change surfaces with draft/proposal authority unless a human gate records acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Type 2 agents such as TASK, PREPARATION, and AUDIT_* execute one sealed deliverable or bounded check with explicit scope and hold draft/proposal authority only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Deterministic tools validate schemas, tests, dependency records, links, scans, hashes, and status discovery as evidence only; tools do not judge acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: TASK is the generic bounded-task shell that normalizes the effective brief, honors explicit write authorization, loads a declared skill only when one exists, executes inside the allowed boundary, and writes a durable run record under the selected deliverable's _run_records/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: ScopePath, DeliverablePath, and profile labels do not grant write authority by themselves.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Agentic coordination should change when the dominant project uncertainty changes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Deliverables, DAG records, review states, application code, and issuance records are not interchangeable work surfaces.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 1 (Intent externalization) asks what we are trying to define, with the normal work unit a package or deliverable scaffold and emphasis on authority intake, deliverable identity, scope boundaries, acceptance criteria, and open questions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 2 (Dependency resolution) asks what depends on what, with the normal work unit a dependency edge, blocker, or clarifying deliverable note and emphasis on DAG semantics, cycle checks, edge amendments, blockers, and graph validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 3 (Deliverable maturation) asks whether a deliverable is sufficiently defined and evidenced, with the work unit one deliverable or a small dependency-linked set and emphasis on local memory, issue burn-down, acceptance evidence, validation, and bounded improvement.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 4 (CHECKING transition) asks whether a deliverable is ready for formal checking, with the work unit a review candidate and emphasis on review packet completeness, residual issue policy, status update authority, and audit trail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 5 (Application integration) asks what bounded app capability should become real next, with the work unit an app slice spanning UI, core, fixtures, tests, and evidence, and emphasis on the working desktop application, intake, cross-deliverable context, fan-in, and preview boundary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 6 (App feedback and gap closure) asks what the application reveals that documents did not, with the work unit an app-discovered gap or failed workflow and emphasis on smoke evidence, gap classification, routing, and before/after validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Phase 7 (Issuance) asks whether a deliverable is formally accepted as authoritative, with the work unit a human-approved issuance candidate and emphasis on final evidence, immutable records, human gate, frozen ISSUED authority, and formal change path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The stable coordination heuristic is to externalize intent as deliverables, resolve dependencies into a usable graph, mature deliverables until reviewable, move them into CHECKING, shift ordinary work to product integration, use the working application to expose gaps, and issue through a separate human-gated lifecycle path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The important transition is from deliverable production to product integration: mature deliverables define intended behavior but the working application tests whether those intentions compose.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Once the DAG is coherent and deliverables are in CHECKING, ordinary work should default to bounded app slices, while formal issuance remains separate from ordinary development.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every agent instance must operate from its local instructions, authority surfaces, current state, write scope, validation expectations, and handoff rules, and must not require awareness of other instantiations, prior sessions, or higher-level recursion.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The coordination surface specs are used when changing the development loop.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In this repository execution/_Coordination/NEXT_INSTANCE_PROMPT.md currently performs the NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md role.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: A separate NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md is a possible future split for compact mutable handoff state but must not become substitute authority unless the coordination record explicitly adopts it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 1, _COORDINATION.md should define project authority, package and deliverable naming rules, allowed scaffolding write scopes, TASK brief requirements, and the loop for selecting missing or underspecified deliverables, and should require purpose, scope, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and open questions per deliverable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 1, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase INTENT_EXTERNALIZATION, packages and deliverables created or missing, incomplete contexts, unresolved project assumptions, the last scaffold check, and dirty git state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 1, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session to read authority, inspect the deliverable register and missing contexts, select one bounded scaffold or enrichment tranche, and avoid dependency closure unless explicitly requested.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 1 init prompt should remain minimal and end with a clause to consider one bounded deliverable-scaffolding or intent-clarification tranche and spawn TASK agents only for independent deliverables with explicit briefs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 2, _COORDINATION.md should define dependency relation semantics, the source of truth for dependency records, edge amendment rules, cycle detection, blocker handling, and the criteria for a usable DAG.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 2, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION, the active DAG identifier, known cycles, missing or ambiguous edges, deliverables blocked by dependency issues, the last DAG validation result, and open human questions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 2, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session to read the deliverable register, dependency records, and DAG artifacts, run dependency validation, select one bounded dependency-resolution tranche, and avoid maturing deliverables beyond what is needed for graph closure.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 2 init prompt clause should be to consider one bounded dependency-resolution tranche and spawn TASK agents only for separable edge-analysis or deliverable-clarification briefs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 3, _COORDINATION.md should define maturity criteria, local memory and run-record expectations, acceptance-evidence requirements, DAG-guided work selection, and rules for reducing blockers and TBDs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 3, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase DELIVERABLE_MATURATION, the active DAG pointer, ready and blocked deliverables, deliverables with high TBD or open-issue burden, the last completed tranche, and validation evidence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 3, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session to run status and DAG discovery, select one bounded deliverable-maturation tranche, prefer deliverables whose dependencies are mature enough, spawn TASK agents only for independent deliverable-local improvements, and record evidence and residual blockers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 3 init prompt clause should be to consider one bounded deliverable-maturation tranche and spawn TASK agents only for explicit deliverable-local scopes with clear acceptance criteria.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 4, _COORDINATION.md should define CHECKING entry criteria, review packet requirements, allowed residual issues, status-update authority, and review evidence expectations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 4, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase CHECKING_TRANSITION, deliverables eligible for CHECKING, deliverables already in CHECKING, rejected candidates needing remediation, last review results, and current status counts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 4, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session to run status summary, select review candidates, inspect deliverable-local context, memory, evidence, and dependency status, change status only when criteria are met, and record review rationale.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 4 init prompt clause should be to consider one bounded review tranche to move mature deliverables toward CHECKING and spawn TASK agents only for separable review or remediation briefs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 5, _COORDINATION.md should define application integration as the default loop, name app/code/test/fixture/build surfaces, state when cross-deliverable work is allowed, define the technical-preview boundary, and name validation commands for app tranches.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 5, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase APPLICATION_INTEGRATION, current app status, working or failing build and test commands, active app gaps, relevant CHECKING deliverables used as design context, known ISSUED deliverables, dirty git state, and any active tranche.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 5, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session to inspect app/build/test surfaces first, use the DAG only to discover related deliverable context, select one bounded app-integration tranche, spawn TASK agents only for separable subscopes with disjoint write scopes, and preserve the technical-preview limits.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 5 init prompt clause should be to consider one bounded app-integration tranche toward the working application and spawn TASK agents only for separable subscopes with explicit briefs and disjoint write scopes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 6, _COORDINATION.md should define the app-driven feedback loop, smoke-test and workflow evidence, gap categories, routing rules for each gap type, and the conditions under which an app finding reopens deliverable work.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 6, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase APP_FEEDBACK_AND_GAP_CLOSURE, last smoke and test results, known app-discovered gaps, gap classification, fixes in progress, deliverables affected by app findings, and validation commands still failing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 6, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session to run or inspect latest app validation, select one bounded gap-closure tranche, prefer fixes that unblock visible workflows, update deliverable review artifacts only when the app reveals a real deliverable issue, and record before/after evidence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 6 init prompt clause should be to consider one bounded app-feedback or gap-closure tranche and spawn TASK agents only when the gap can be split into independent code, fixture, schema, or review scopes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 7, _COORDINATION.md should define ISSUED criteria, the human approval gate, immutable evidence requirements, the change path for already-issued deliverables, final review and closure records, and boundary language for release, professional, legal, certification, and code-compliance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 7, NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md (if used) should record phase ISSUANCE, deliverables in CHECKING, deliverables eligible for ISSUED, deliverables already ISSUED, human approvals received or pending, final blockers, and the last issuance decision record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: In Phase 7, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md should instruct the next session not to issue anything without human approval, inspect final review packets and evidence, confirm dependency closure and app-related findings, update status to ISSUED only through the approved lifecycle path, and treat ISSUED deliverables as frozen authority unless a formal change path opens them.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Phase 7 init prompt clause should be to consider one human-approved issuance tranche and not select ISSUED deliverables for ordinary work, reopening them only through the formal change path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 1: perform authority intake from the coordination record, directive, contract, types, IP/data policy, approved DAG pointer, approved DAG record, and relevant decomposition/register rows, with evidence noted in the run record or final handoff.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 2: confirm the assigned DeliverableID, PackageID, scope items, objectives, acceptance criteria, and allowed write scope, with evidence from the sealed brief and deliverable _CONTEXT.md.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 3: inspect the current worktree and deliverable-local packet before editing and treat unrelated changes as other-worker or user work, with evidence from git status --short and local file reads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 4: use DAG context only to discover relevant upstream/downstream context and inspect local artifacts where needed, with evidence from approved DAG edge context plus cited local files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 5: execute only the bounded task and keep unknowns, unsettled policy decisions, missing engineering values, and unsupported source claims as TBD, with evidence being changed files inside the allowed write scope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 6: run focused validation appropriate to the changed surface, with evidence being commands, pass/fail/deferred results, and warnings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 7: update deliverable-local evidence surfaces explicitly authorized by the brief, with evidence in MEMORY.md, _run_records/**, or other approved evidence files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Default development loop step 8: hand off for review or human decision without changing lifecycle state unless that gate was explicitly authorized, and for completed validated development tranches autonomously hand off to CHANGE for final Git/file-state review, scoped commit, and push.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every Type 2 execution needs an explicit work contract.

UnitStatement: A Type 2 work contract requires one DeliverableID and parent PackageID.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: A Type 2 work contract requires applicable invariants from docs/CONTRACT.md.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: A Type 2 work contract requires acceptance criteria from the sealed brief or _CONTEXT.md.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: A Type 2 work contract requires explicit allowed write targets.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: A Type 2 work contract requires validation commands or evidence expectations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Public work may include open mechanics, schemas, blank templates, workflow docs, invented examples, original examples, and permissively licensed material with documented provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Public work must not include protected standards text, tables, figures, examples, copied code-derived formulas, proprietary vendor data without rights, private project models, owner standards, private rule packs, company design bases, credentials, or real secrets.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Maintainer acceptance of a repository contribution is project governance only and is not professional engineering approval of a piping calculation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Software and agents do not certify, seal, authenticate, approve, or declare engineering code compliance for reliance.

UnitStatement: The project license has been selected as PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The final contributor legal mechanism, maintainer roster/quorum, release authority, legal-review authority, security contact, release-label vocabulary, human-acceptance workflow, jurisdiction-specific professional-practice wording, CI provider/coverage thresholds, and exact dependency versions remain TBD unless recorded by the human project authority or qualified reviewer.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Stop and escalate through the assigned review, CHANGE, SOFTWARE_DECOMP, or human project-authority path when the requested work crosses package or deliverable boundaries.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-AGENTIC-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW -> CAT-020.
